{icon:bullet,1.2} You reflect Stun and Knockback effects. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Your Minimum Resolve is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} and Maximum Resolve is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} and you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2" |%+|]{/c} Damage Reduction for each Minimum Resolve you have.
